name: NxNZ 2019

venue.name: [The Picton Centre](https://pictoncentre.co.nz/clifton)
venue.address: 120 Picton St, Howick, Auckland 2014, New Zealand

information: NxNZ 2019 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. Speedcubing is solving the 3x3x3 Cube or other similar puzzles as quickly as possible (except 3x3x3 Fewest Moves). The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place so as to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the days on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA regulations.
